name: MATH 3510
title: Numerical Analysis I
description: Analysis of numerical methods associated with linear systems, eigenvalues, inverses of matrices, zeros of non-linear functions and polynomials. Roundoff error and computational speed.
requirement_description: Either (i) MATH 2110Q or 2130Q, and MATH 2410Q, and MATH 2210Q or 3210; or (ii) MATH 2144Q; knowledge of at least one programming language. May not be taken out of sequence after passing MATH 3511.
